Sezzle's standard pay-in-4 plan splits your purchase into 4 equal installments over 6 weeks. You pay 25% at the time of checkout, and the remaining 25% is charged every 2 weeks. These installments are automatically charged to your default payment method on the due date. You can pay any installment early at no cost, though this does not change the due dates of your remaining payments. Sezzle charges no interest for this plan. Please note that some merchants may offer different plans, so you should check your specific order details in the app for the exact schedule.
